Home - Honeyleads

# Fresh Leads Dripped Into Your Inbox. Every Day.

Say hello to highly converting cold email campaigns. 100% done-for-you, so you can book more meetings and experience the sweet freedom of ridiculously effective lead gen.

## Our Clients

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

# So, What’s Included with HoneyLeads? Well, Everything.

HoneyLeads takes care of everything so you can focus on what matters: booking calls and closing deals.

- Custom Strategy
- Senders Domains + Emails
- Sending Infrastructure
- Copywriting
- List Building
- Inbox Monitoring & Replies

# Take a 👀 Inside Our Clients Inboxes

No one likes getting a cold email, well except maybe the people getting ours. Here’s a peak at the kind of responses our email campaigns get. 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

# A Proven Process. A Hands-Off Approach.

HoneyLeads sends up to 1,000 personalized emails every day to influence key decision makers who can’t help but respond to your product or service. 

### 1. Learn Your Secret Sauce

We get into the nitty gritty to learn what makes your product or service irresistible to your target audience and leverage those points into your strategy.

### 2. Find Your Most Qualified Prospects

Using key data points like job titles, industries, geography, company size, revenue, etc., we build a list of your most qualified prospects.

### 3. Write Head-Turning Emails

We don’t write emails that make your prospects go “meh”. With inboxes full of cookie-cutter emails, we make sure yours captures attention.

### 4. Leverage Tech & Deliverability

We set up dedicated domains and an advanced tech stack to ensure that your emails land in the spotlight of the main inbox, avoiding the spam folder.

### 5. Launch & Optimize

Once your campaign is launched, we track leads to consistently optimize performance and your ROI, and forward you the most qualified leads every day.

### "We’ve been able to drive a very consistent flow of leads month over month"

I was very concerned cold email may not be the right solution as its is known to be incredibly boring and dismissable. Kyley told us we were going to do things differently. I was impressed how she got under the hood of our business, industry, and target audience, and even the nuances of the slang that’s used in order for her to write a cold email that could drive leads…and she did exactly that.

– Ben Gerster, CEO, Joybyte

### "I’d pay twice as much as I do…"

…just because of the revenue we’ve been able to generate through their campaigns. It’s one thing to get leads, its another to get quality leads, and that’s been the game changer working with Kyley.

– Allan Porter, CEO, Porter Media

### “2 months in, leads have already converted into clients"

We’ve gotten so much positive feedback. The clients have been commenting on how creative the emails are. I get at least one email a day saying “I usually trash these emails,” but yours got my attention and that’s why i’m responding. We’re super happy…highly recommend.”

– Joseph Segal, Founder, The Glove Zone

### "It’s been an absolutely awesome experience."

Kyley’s been able to work with us to tailor the outbound leads to the types of clients we want. She’s never led us in the wrong direction, she’s always been honest about expectations and been very fair along the way. I have nothing but great things to say.

– Nicholas Rhodes, Founder, OutSnapped

### “Kyley has been an absolute delight to work with.”

Prior to using her services, our company was either sourcing leads ourselves or working with ineffective SDR services that struggled to schedule meetings with our ICP. 

After we started using Kyley’s services, what really stuck out to me was her innate desire to both understand our product, ICP and market served. Where other SDR services just cared about crafting a catchy message to lure in prospective clients, Kyley went above and beyond to actually understand why our ICPs wanted our products and consistently dug into the “Why” of our product and pitch. As a result, her messaging and outreach effort led to more meetings scheduled and subsequently closed deals.

You will not regret working with Kyley – she is great at what she does and always makes herself available as well as being very cost effective! 

– Gabriel Weisz, CEO, Kallpod

### “We gave her full reigns to do her thing...”

Selling financial services via cold email is a nightmare, particularly with the ERC since so much Spam is out there for that. However, we knew we had a short window to reach as many business owners, CEOs, and CFOs as possible. Kyley offered us a way to do it quickly at scale (and somehow personalize each email). We gave her full reigns to do her thing…12 months later and we already have $1M of revenue, and over $5M more of signed deals in the pipeline from her campaign. 

– Paul Warshaw, COO, Bottom Line Savings

### “We were hesitant to start cold email campaigns until...”

“As a business previously built on referrals, we were hesitant to start cold email campaigns until we found Kyley. She got to know our business and wrote campaigns that spoke to our values and product in a way that we were proud of. Kyley doesn’t just run cold email campaigns but was a trusted advisor and teacher for our sales team. We found our largest client since the pandemic through her outreach!” 

 – Gavin Crynes COO JustFare

### “We have had calls with very large brands”

I get hundreds of sales pitches claiming they can help build a pipeline of qualified new leads. I took the call with Kyley and knew from the start that if anyone could help me it was her. Our goal was lofty and she worked with us to help us craft the right message and thoroughly thought through the process of what the potential client’s pain points were. I genuinely feel as if she is as invested in this process as I am! In just under 2 months, on top of all the leads, we have had 6-7 calls with very large Fortune500 brands 

– Paula Bruno, Intuition Media

### "Kyley really surprised us. Immediately we saw responses in our inbox and have continued to see those responses.”

#### Working with Kyley has enabled us to make connections with prospects that we probably wouldn’t have made otherwise. We’ve run cold email campaigns in the past and the results were not as successful, so I was hesitant to pursue investing in another cold email agency. Kyley really surprised us. Immediately we saw responses in our inbox and have continued to see those responses. If you’re a business that wants to stand out from the hundreds of emails people get a day and actually book meetings with high quality leads, Kyley and her team are a no-brainer.

– Alfredo Fernandez-Concha, Chief Growth Officer, Castle Connolly Private Health Partners

### Your Business Before

- Wasting time on cold email articles and videos
- Sending emails that sound like everyone else. Yawn.
- Scraping a clunky tech stack and system together
- Paying an arm and a leg for lackluster SDR teams

### Your Business After

- Insanely effective cold emails that work
- Getting qualified new leads every day
- Lead gen that pays for itself - many times over
- A whole team obsessing over your campaigns

# We Care Obsess About Your Results

Our team knows more about B2B cold email at scale than just about anyone.

### KYLEY CHEEVER — FOUNDER

Kyley has been writing captivating cold emails since she could (legally) have her first drink. An entrepreneur who started two service-based businesses with zero contacts, zero connections and zero money meant she had to learn how to sell. And sell fast. The good news? This led her to obsessively learn how to identify, influence and convert decision makers using the power of subject lines, copy and technical back-end of cold email. With a track record of helping businesses and sales teams rapidly grow and scale through B2B cold email, she officially founded HoneyLeads. The rest is history.

### NICOLE — SALES MANAGER

Nicole brings a knack for insanely effective outreach that helps achieve HoneyLead’s mission of helping busy entrepreneurs grow their business without friction.

### CAMERON LEWIS — OPERATIONS

Cam is essentially the human equivalent of a Swiss Army knife for our team—he’s got a tool for every task and a process for every pickle. When he isn't working, he is likely either out hunting wild game in the dense pine woodlands, on a hiking adventure with his kids, or sharing a peaceful moment with his wife.

### FRANCIS SALAZAR — CAMPAIGN SUPPORT

Francis is all about people and processes. He doesn’t just keep tabs on our inboxes to send you those fresh, happy leads every day, but also puts together those much-needed lists and sheets for your campaigns. When he's not making a mess with coffee (still figuring out how to brew), you'll catch him watching one of LeBron's winning matches (because he can’t watch him lose).

### MARY DHEN DANZA — CAMPAIGN SUPPORT

Mary is the star player of our team who knows every process inside out and if she's out even for a power nap, we're all secretly counting the seconds until her return. One minute she's handling crazy-complex intimidating tasks - the next, she's knee-deep in an episode of 'How I Met Your Mother,' laughing like she's never seen it before, even though it's probably her 27th run.

### Ahmad Nouman — Copywriter

Ahmad is a top 3% copywriter and a sales nerd who knows how to bring ideas from books into real life. Born in the bridge year between Millennials and Gen Z, he comes with a knack for tech and a natural 'flair' for avoiding buzzwords like 'flair,' 'vibe,' and 'aesthetic.' He loves reading books, hands, faces, and the stars.

### Who exactly is this for? 

If you’re a B2B business doing well in your current market and ready to scale – this is for you. To meet our criteria, you must: 

- Sell B2B
- Sell nationally to a target market of at least 20-30k verified contacts.
- Have an average deal size of over $3500
- Be obsessed with following-up on leads
- Know how to close deals (or a team that does)

### Does cold email still work? I tried it once. 

We’ve had many clients who “tried” cold email only to realize they were doing it all wrong. Why? They (or their agency) were sending generic emails, focusing on vanity metrics, or using gimmicks that drove prospects away. Cold email isn’t going anywhere, but nailing it is harder than ever. That’s why we exist.

### What is considered a “lead”? 

Anyone who responds to us about booking a call, wants more info, or asks us to check in later is what we call a ‘lead.’ But if someone replies with ‘not right now’ or ‘no thanks, but we’ll keep you in mind,’ we don’t count that as a lead.

### Can’t I do this myself? 

You can give it a shot – but it’ll take a ton of blood and sweat (and tears). A lot of our clients have tried to handle this in-house only to realize it was a massive headache. The truth is, nailing effective cold email at scale isn’t easy unless you’re living and breathing it every single day. We do.

### Are these customized offerings? 

Yes! Everything we do is customized towards your brand, niche and target audience. While our model is reverse engineered across various B2B niches, there’s no cookie cutter.

### Do you offer cold calls, LinkedIn prospecting, SMS texting? 

We don’t, but those are a great addition to supplement our campaigns with. We focus on what we do best: cold email at scale.

### Do you offer data on open rates, click through rates etc.? 

These days, a lot of services love to sell you on vanity metrics that aren’t even accurate. But we keep our eyes on what really matters: replies that turn into booked calls and inked deals.

# Get Started in 3 Steps

Getting started with most agencies is more complex than taking out a mortgage. HoneyLeads get you up and running in a few simple steps.

### Book Call

Just a quick call where we get to know you and discuss how we can help you crush all your goals.

### Gameplan. Choose Your Sweetness Level

Creating a proven gameplan from our call to revamp your lead gen.

### Launch

Getting your campaign up and running so you can enjoy the revenue-generating sweet perks of outbound emailing. Done the right way.

Done-for-you, highly converting cold emails so you can close more deals and experience the freedom of ridiculously effective lead gen. Oh, that’s sweet.

Questions? We’re Here!

kyley@honeyleads.io

About KNK Outbound: Founders, Services, Key Facts

# Founder-led. Done for you.

KNK Outbound is a B2B lead generation agency that runs outbound end to end for B2B companies in Europe and the US, from the target list to reply handling, so only qualified conversations land in your calendar.

Founded

2026, Munich

Pricing

From €3,300, all-in

Markets

Europe and the US

Model

Done for you

- Qualified conversations The outcome
- Offer & message Nicklas
- Sending & deliverability Kenneth
- Data & buying signals Kenneth

In short

KNK Outbound is a B2B lead generation agency founded in Munich in 2026 by brothers Kenneth Kather (founder & CEO) and Nicklas Kather (co-founder). It runs outbound end to end: researched target lists, cold email and LinkedIn, handling every reply, calling interested prospects personally and booking the meetings. Content and ads run alongside only where they help. Clients only get qualified conversations in their calendar. Pricing is public, from EUR 3,300 a month with everything included.

### Outbound with cold email

We research the companies that genuinely fit you, find a real reason to reach out, and write short messages that a person reviews before sending. Sending runs on separate domains and mailboxes, so your main domain stays protected. You do not have to set up anything.

### LinkedIn outreach

We reach the same decision makers on LinkedIn in parallel, within safe weekly limits and with messages about the recipient. That builds familiarity before the first conversation takes place.

### Replies, calls and booking

We handle every reply, answer questions and call every interested prospect personally while the interest is fresh. Then we qualify against a written definition and book the meeting straight into your calendar. Your team only takes the conversations.

01

### Fully done for you

We take on everything: research, infrastructure, copy, sending, LinkedIn, reply handling, calls to interested prospects and booking. Many providers only deliver contacts or campaigns and leave the replies with your team.

### Public prices, everything included

From EUR 3,300 a month, with tools, data, domains and mailboxes included and no setup fee. Many agencies only share prices on a call and bill tools and data on top.

03

### Ranges, not meeting promises

We publish honest ranges per funnel stage and do not charge per meeting. Providers paid per booked meeting have an incentive to fill calendars with conversations that do not fit.

04

### Founders, not juniors

Both founders stay personally accountable for every engagement, from the first call to day-to-day operations. In larger agencies an account often moves to rotating junior managers after the sale.

### Native German and English

German copy is written by native speakers with UWG and GDPR in mind per channel. English campaigns for the US run from the same system. Recipients recognize translated US templates in the first sentence.

Check us

> Ask ChatGPT or Claude about KNK Outbound, about our benchmarks, or about the questions you should ask any agency. Or connect your assistant directly to knkoutbound.com/mcp.

- Software and SaaS companies with 10 to 200 employees

- Manufacturing and industrial mid-sized companies

## The team behind KNK Outbound

KNK Outbound was founded in Munich in February 2026 by brothers Kenneth and Nicklas Kather. The idea: offer outbound the way they would want to buy it, with public prices, honest numbers and a service that takes all the work off the client's plate.

Leads the business side: first calls, the offer and ideal customer profile per engagement, and the message, meaning the question of why a decision maker should reply at all. The face of our YouTube channel.

### Who is Kenneth Kather?

Kenneth Kather is the founder and CEO of KNK Outbound, a B2B lead generation agency founded in Munich in 2026. He owns the systems side of client engagements: target data, buying signals, sending infrastructure and deliverability, and writes the technical guides and benchmarks on the KNK blog.

### Who is behind KNK Outbound?

Brothers Kenneth Kather (founder & CEO, systems and engineering) and Nicklas Kather (co-founder, clients and message). The agency is founder-led: both stay personally accountable for every engagement, supported by the team and a fixed technology stack.

### How much does KNK Outbound cost?

From EUR 3,300 a month for the Start package with 10,000 leads contacted per month, EUR 6,500 for Growth with 30,000 and EUR 9,000 for Scale with 60,000, with full coverage quoted individually. Tools, data, domains and mailboxes are always included, and prices exclude VAT.

### What do I have to do myself as a client?

Only take the conversations. KNK handles research, infrastructure, copy, sending, LinkedIn, every reply and the booking. At the start you align the ideal customer profile and messaging with us and approve target lists.

### Who is KNK Outbound a good fit for?

B2B companies with a deal value above roughly EUR 5,000, several hundred to tens of thousands of fitting target companies, and someone who takes first meetings within a day. Below roughly EUR 3,000 deal value or in very small markets, we advise against it.

### How long has KNK Outbound existed, and why trust a young agency?

KNK was founded in 2026, and that is exactly why everything is verifiable rather than claimed: public pricing, results as honest ranges and a methodology documented in 100+ guides. We explicitly invite prospects to check us with ChatGPT or Claude.

### How long until the first campaigns run?

About three weeks. Weeks one and two cover the ideal customer profile, messaging and infrastructure, and in week three the first campaigns go live.

Signal-driven outbound systems that book qualified meetings. Built and run for you.
